questions.stem: ABC is a right angled triangle at C, AB = 13 cm, BC = 12 cm. A: Find the length AC. B: Find each of the following: sin A, cos A, tan A, sin B, cos B, tan B. C: Prove that: sin A cos B + cos A sin B = 1. D: Find: 1 + tan² A. Prove that: sin A cos B + cos A sin B = 1
solution: The right side = $\sin A\cos B+\cos A\sin B$

questions.stem: In the figure opposite: ABC is an isosceles triangle and a right angled triangle at C. The length of each leg is L. Complete: $m(\angle A) = \ldots^\circ$, $m(\angle B) = \ldots^\circ$
solution: Triangle ABC is isosceles with right angle at C, and AC = BC.
So the base angles at A and B are equal.
The angles of a triangle add up to 180°, so each of them is (180° - 90°) ÷ 2 = 45°.
